targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroup(requested_at, '$__interval') AS time, count(*) AS requests FROM predictions WHERE $__timeFilter(requested_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT $__timeGroup(requested_at, '$__interval') AS time, percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY latency_ms) AS p50_latency_ms, percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY latency_ms) AS p95_latency_ms FROM predictions WHERE $__timeFilter(requested_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT $__timeGroup(requested_at, '$__interval') AS time, 100.0 * sum(CASE WHEN status = 'error' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / count(*) AS error_rate_pct FROM predictions WHERE $__timeFilter(requested_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT count(*)::float / GREATEST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (max(requested_at) - min(requested_at))) / 60.0, 1) AS requests_per_minute FROM predictions WHERE $__timeFilter(requested_at)
SELECT model_name || ' ' || model_version || ' (' || model_alias || ')' AS active_model FROM predictions ORDER BY requested_at DESC LIMIT 1
